settings.text:
§l§6FPS Optimizer 
§7Eleven controls, no reinstall. Everything here applies in §fboth§7 subpacks.§r
§7Scales how many particles every effect below §fspawns§7. §f100§7 is vanilla, §f0§7 is none.§r

§7A hard ceiling on any single effect, applied §fafter§7 the slider above. Most effects spawn 1-5 and never reach it — this exists for splash potions, which throw §f30§7 at once.§r
§f32§7 = nothing capped. Drop to §f8§7 to flatten the spikes.§r
§7Swirls on you and on mobs, splash potions and lingering clouds.§r
§7Witch brewing puffs and evoker spell casts. Worth cutting for raids.§r
§7The trail behind tipped arrows. Heavy in PvP and skeleton fights.§r
§7Geyser columns, plumes and puffs. Max FPS removes these outright.§r
§7Sulfur bubbles and cubes in sulfur caves.§r
§7Stops orbs drawing. They still work and are still collected — the biggest single gain at mob grinders.§r

§7The shimmer on enchanted armor, shields, bows, crossbows and tridents is a §fsecond draw§7 of the same model. Off skips that pass on every player and mob in view — the gear still renders, only the glow goes. Biggest in PvP lobbies and at farms where every drop is enchanted.§r

§7Durability HUD, numbered hotbar, animated durability bars, 89-biome fog coverage, static block animations and blocky Vibrant Visuals shadows and caustics-free Vibrant Visuals water are built in and need no configuration.§r

§7Chosen in the list above, not here:§r
§c▪ Max FPS §7— fog at 60 blocks, 177 effects removed
§a▪ Default §7— fog past the horizon, 48 effects removed§r
